reviews.comment: Absolutely phenomenal professor. I wish I could take her over and over again, but I'm so grateful I had her during my last semester at TAMU. She is truly so caring and interested in each student. She makes learning so much fun and has many engaging activities throughout the semester. If you have the chance, please take her!! We love you, Dr. Wolfe!

All the reviews about her are accurate. Inspiring and cares about what she is teaching. Brought me back to a better time in my education, like elementary, ya know. Anyway, there is one midterm, a wildfire simulation group project, and there's not really a final because honor students do the final project. You just need to show up and give feedback.

Anna was honestly one of the best professors I have ever had. Class was an 8am so I didn't show up as much as I wish I did, but I should've because she was soo smart and kind and passionate and the lectures were so interesting and involving. Take her you will not regret it, I wish I could again.

This was probaby the best professor I have had here at Texas A&M, if you have the opportunity to take her class just do it! Attendance is mandatory, but you can miss 2 classes without penalty. There are no exams in this course just an essay at the end and small in class assignments as well as a few things outside of class that are actually fun.

I mean I cannot come up with enough good things about Dr. Wolfe!!! She is an incredible professor, and I absolutely loved taking her class this semester! Attendance not mandatory most days, but I actually wanted to go! Exams are not to trick you, Dr. Wolfe preps you well! Take her if you can!!!!!!!!  She cares deeply for her students!

Anna Wolfe is an inspiration to her students! She looks you in your eyes, asks your name, and treats you like an intelligent human being. While attendance isn't required, her lectures are worth going to as they are interesting and inspiring (especially if you're a orgl comm nerd like me). Loved every second in her class. She'seriously incredible!!

Anna is an amazing professor. I took the class because it fit well with my schedule but it ended up being one of my favorite classes. There are 2 exams, which aren't terribly hard if you study the material. We have 10 in class activities where you actually do hands on activities like icing cookies and using Ai to make posters. Take her if you can!

By far the best professor at Texas A&M in the Communication Department. Anna cares so much about her students and her lectures are very entertaining. There is a midterm and a final and then everything else is participation and group work. Great professor and entertaining class! 10/10

I love this professor, and I hope I get to take her again. This was my favorite class at TAMU, and it is because of her. She wants every student to do well and is the sweetest professor I've ever had. She goes above and beyond to make the content applicable and interesting.

No doubt the best professor and class I have ever taken at A&M. Dr. Wolfe is so kind and her lectures are absolutely incredible. I was so excited to go to her class every week. Course consisted of two exams and class participation in your groups that she assigns based on career goals. Again, the best class and professor I have ever taken!!!

Honestly, there was only 10 assignments that require you to go to class and 2 exams. The exams are tough but if you study youll get and A, assignments are super easy. Took this as an upper level elective. Book wasnt really necessary.
Dr. Wolfe is an incredible professor. She cares about her students so much and is the nicest prof I have ever had. If you ever have the chance, take her. You will not regret it.

Anna Wolfe is by far my favorite professor. She truly cares about her students and is always there for help whenever you need her. There are in-class activities (she tells you the dates of these) which are super engaging, so make sure you go to these because it will help your grade. She also gives an outline of what is on the exams. Take her!!!

Anna Wolfe is the most transformational professor and leader at TAMU. I cannot tel you how much of an honor it was to get to be in her class. If you ever have the chance to take her, for any class, do it.

Incredible. I respect Dr. Wolfe so much. Taking another class with her next semester. Very competent and passionate. Discussion-based class. Talked about a lot of difficult and complex issues and ideas and it was so thought-provoking. I talk about this prof (and this class) with friends/family/employers. Highly recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Wolfe has been the absolute best professor I ever had. She is an incredible lecturer, genuinely cares about students and makes everything interesting. She had two exams and a lot of in class assignments. The exams are tough but the assignments are pretty easy. Do the study guides, reading, listen in class and you should be fine!
One of the most caring profs I've had here at A&M. Hoping to take more courses with Anna in the future!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: BEST PROF EVER! Currently taking this class and woke up late for an exam. I freaked out and reached out to her and she was very accommodating and sweet. Overall one of the best profs I've ever had!

She is incredible. I truly cannot say enough good things about her. She is so passionate about what she teaches and makes every effort to get to know her students on a personal level. This was the first class I have ever taken where we actually applied what we learned to real-life. She is hands-down the best professor I have ever had. MUST TAKE.

I absolutely LOVE Professor Wolfe. She is honestly an amazing human and really really cares about her students. The class is mostly participation and working on things in pairs or in groups. There are no exams but there are quite a few easyish assignments. If you go to class and follow directions it is an easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Great prof. New so no one really knows anything about her. Awesome class. Hands on. Small class so a lot of group participation but if you don't like to speak you don't have to, it's not graded. Down to earth, fun, funny, and relatable. I would take every COMM class I could with her.
